about: Each control's state in the sim (modern-iaf/docs/manuals.md §2): per node of the cockpit's control table, and per lamp, gauge and display that chapter 1 of the manuals numbers, status (works: does its real job; partly: only lights a lamp or caution, or only one position does anything; moves: the control moves, nothing else happens; none: a lamp, gauge or display the sim does not drive) and a short note. From the controls audit of 18 November 2026 and a trace of each lamp, gauge and display to the reader of its state (shared/cockpit/cockpit3d.gd). tools/manuals.py stops the manuals' build on a control without a status.

HMD_MODE.note: OFF darkens the helmet display; NIGHT, AUTO and DAY leave its brightness to the BRT rocker: the sim has no light sensor and dims no display range.

VIDEO_BRT.note: Steps the helmet picture's brightness (the night camera's and the DAS video's).

VIDEO_CONT.note: Steps the helmet picture's contrast (the night camera's and the DAS video's).

MFD_MODE.note: The sim dims the display at night by itself; it has no separate day and night range.

COM_A.note: The radio calls' volume, none at the stop.

COM_B.note: The sim's radio calls are on COM A; nothing is heard on COM B.

COM_C.note: The sim's radio calls are on COM A; nothing is heard on COM C.

SFD_BARO.note: The standby display shows the true altitude: the sim has no barometric setting.

SFD_ALIGN.note: The standby display's attitude never drifts in the sim: there is nothing to align.

SFD_BRT.note: The sim has no brightness of the standby display's own.

PEDAL_ADJ.note: The pedals' reach does not matter in the sim: the rudder is the keys' and the joystick's.

HOOK.note: The jet has no arresting hook in the sim, and no source names the cockpit's indication of one.

JETT_SEL.note: ALL, EXT or SEL: what the emergency jettison drops. It starts at ALL.

ALT_GEAR_GUARD.note: A guard: it gates its switch, its real job.

LAND_TAXI.note: The landing or the taxi light outside, with the gear down at night.

AUTO_RECOVERY.note: OFF silences the "Pull up" call; the automatic fly-up itself is not modelled.

ZEROIZE.note: The sim holds no classified data to erase.

FCS_RESET.note: The sim's flight control faults are battle damage, which a reset does not clear.

ENG_GUARD.note: A guard: it gates its switch, its real job.

VS_BIT.note: The sim models no vehicle systems' built-in test.

THR_FRICTION.note: The throttle is the keys' and the joystick's: it has no friction to set.

THR_ACTIVE.note: The throttle is the keys' and the joystick's: it has no active feel.

ICC1.note: The sim does not model the power converters: the jet's power is the battery's and the generator's.

ICC2.note: The sim does not model the power converters: the jet's power is the battery's and the generator's.

CABIN_PRESS.note: The sim does not model the cabin's pressure on this jet.

IPP_EMER_OFF_GUARD.note: A guard: it gates its switch, its real job.

IPP_EMER_OFF.note: Shuts the IPP down, as the IPP switch at OFF.

STICK_ACTIVE.note: The stick is the keys' and the joystick's: it has no active feel.

DEFOG.note: The sim has no fog on the canopy.

MDC.note: The sim has no ground egress through the canopy.

EJECT_HANDLE.note: Pulled three times within a second each, with the seat at ARM: the ejection, as the E key.

SEAT_SAFE.note: At ARM the firing handle fires the seat; SAFE and MOH hold it. SAFE on a cold jet.

SEAT_HEIGHT.note: The eye's height is the lean keys' alone.

lamp_eng_fire_0.note: The light shows an engine fire; the push fires the extinguisher, as the X key.

PCD.note: By touch and by keys: the MENU grid's 20 formats, the five preset layouts, a portal widened or enlarged, SWAP, the function bar's pop-ups, the SMS's bay doors.
